evidence: WarehouseMapper.mapToORM copies fields from the exported domain state (warehouseEntity.export()) into WarehouseOrmEntity/OrderOrmEntity. This is persistence mapping, which is an infrastructure concern.
WarehouseMapper.mapToDomain rebuilds WarehouseEntity/OrderEntity from ORM rows without applying any business rules.
orderOrm.isValid = orderReadonly.isValid is a plain copy of the field. The file does not compute or check any business rules.
Only warehouse.repository.ts (infrastructure) uses the mapper. This fits its role as a persistence helper.
parsedVerdict.reasoning: WarehouseMapper sits in the DAL (infrastructure). Its only job is translating between domain entities (WarehouseEntity, OrderEntity) and persistence ORM entities (WarehouseOrmEntity, OrderOrmEntity). That is a standard persistence-adapter role, which belongs to infrastructure. The file has no business rules, validation, transport or presentation logic. For example, isValid is copied field-to-field and never computed. All of its responsibilities match the infrastructure layer.
